name: paper-canvas-workflow
description: Manage academic projects, Zotero-linked paper libraries and PDF flows, Overleaf manuscripts, research flows, rebuttals, and camera-ready manuscripts in Obsidian Canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Manage academic paper workflows in Obsidian Canvas.
interface.longDescription: Initialize unified-vault projects, connect Zotero papers and citations, and build manuscript layouts, research flows, rebuttal grids, and camera-ready groups while preserving Obsidian Canvas spatial grammar.
defaultPrompt: Create this paper project in my unified Obsidian vault and connect its Zotero library.
Find literature for each research question and build a PDF-grounded paper flow.
Map this paper into a sentence-level Obsidian Canvas.
Organize these reviewer comments into a rebuttal workflow.
Map camera-ready changes onto paper_v2 without rewriting it.
Create paper_camera_ready and mark revised manuscript nodes yellow.
